reading.title: Supermarket 24: understanding labels and asking staff for help
reading.text: Maya learns store labels before shopping. Fresh and frozen describe food differently. On sale and buy 1 get 1 free describe offers. Best before and nutrition facts give package information; non-GMO and vegan describe other product characteristics. She asks, “How much is this?” and “Where can I find bread?” Staff ask, “Paper or plastic?” and “Cash or card?” Maya asks, “Is this on sale?”, “Do you have rice?” and “Can I get a bag?” before paying.
